dedupe_keys.name: xi an bridge crack images for dbcc

description: This published repository folder contains bridge-crack imagery for training and testing the DBCC detection method. Its own README attributes the images mainly to a viaduct in Xi’an, Shaanxi, and distinguishes training material from an original-image test collection. The latter is described as 2,068 images; the folder name says 1024 by 1024, while the text says 1024 by 1042 pixels. Coverage is those bridge surfaces, with no verified observation period; a January 2017 date appears without a defined meaning. GitHub exposes training-image and split-file paths and links an external test collection. Use is restricted to noncommercial research, despite MIT on the parent repository. A limitation is inconsistent counts between the parent overview and this folder, plus the unresolved image dimensions. Simulation uses include testing bridge-condition observation errors, without converting surface cracks directly into structural capacity. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with civil-asset imagery. The parent tree was truncated, so completeness was not asserted and no images were downloaded.
